capabilities: : Manage project ideas in an inbox
: Define next actions for active projects
extras: Not yet in the community plugin directory.
motivation: The author built it to combat procrastination by enforcing strict limits, keeping all ideas visible, and ensuring every active project has a clear next action.
problem: Users struggle with procrastination and scattered project ideas, leading to analysis paralysis or forgotten tasks.
summary: An opinionated project dashboard that enforces a hard Work In Progress (WIP) limit, tracks time, and manages project ideas to combat procrastination.
